variantPolicy: Seeded variants alter tenant, ingestion delay, aspect, and missing-field conditions; variants are replay aids and not independent published assets.

exercises.title: Build a Reproducible OpenSearch Query Plan
exercises.objective: Investigate a synthetic storefront outage without broad or irreproducible searches.
exercises.initialState: The evidence bundle contains access, application, Catalina, deployment, and business-state records with delayed ingestion.
exercises.prompt: Produce the query sequence, control samples, evidence manifest, privacy treatment, and falsification tests for the supplied tenant and UTC window.
constraints: do not treat empty results as proof

hints.text: Start with the decision the query must inform.
A known-good control can distinguish no traffic from a bad filter.

exercises.referenceSolution: Bound the window and environment, record tenant and documented filters, obtain representative control records, preserve source IDs and timestamps, distinguish ingestion delay, minimize sensitive data, and state the next falsification query.

exercises.title: Reconcile Contradictory Search and Business Evidence
exercises.objective: Separate request outcome, application outcome, and business outcome during an ambiguous order incident.
exercises.initialState: Synthetic access and application records report success while payment and order state remain unresolved.
exercises.prompt: Construct the evidence layers, identify the safe operational state, assign reconciliation ownership, and define closure checks.
constraints: do not close on HTTP status alone
simulation is not live payment execution
exercises.deliverable: Layered evidence table, reconciliation procedure, and closure checklist.

hints.text: Ask what each record actually proves.
Recovery of latency does not settle external state.

exercises.referenceSolution: Keep the incident open for unresolved business state, preserve IDs, reconcile under idempotency and authorization, assign an owner, verify technical and business recovery separately, and retain the synthetic boundary.

exercises.title: Test a Logging Runbook Before Production Use
exercises.objective: Create failure-path tests that prevent a logging runbook from creating false confidence.
exercises.initialState: A draft runbook searches one fixed field and assumes dashboard order equals event order.
exercises.prompt: Design deterministic fixtures, assertions, provider/runtime checks, and evidence requirements for the runbook.
constraints: distinguish local simulation from SAP runtime
exercises.deliverable: Test matrix, corrected runbook gates, and execution evidence manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: field mapping and empty result ambiguity tested

hints.text: Attack every assumption the draft makes.
The runbook is part of the system and needs regression evidence.

exercises.referenceSolution: Add deterministic fixtures for query and evidence failure modes, require privacy-safe bounded packages, replay the runbook by another operator, and execute platform forwarding/permission checks only against the selected supported runtime.
